method: Resolved every documented source against pinned read-only git commits, recorded source and library hashes, extracted reference exports, and checked shared styles in a browser. Component source is adapted to tokens and reusable props. Source coverage does not certify every variant as visually or behaviorally identical.

measurements.method: Computed styles in Chromium at 1440px and 390px with reduced motion and loaded fonts. Font-size, weight, line height, tracking, colors, borders, and padding; font family names differ under Next font hashing.
